scheme_name: National TB Elimination Programme – Digital Initiative
overview: The National TB Elimination Programme – Digital Initiative, known as Nikshay, is a web-enabled patient management system for TB control under the National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme (NTEP). It is developed and maintained by the Central TB Division (CTD), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India, in collaboration with the National Informatics Centre (NIC) and the World Health Organization Country office for India. Nikshay is used by health functionaries across the country in both public and private sectors to register TB cases, order tests, record treatment details, monitor adherence, and transfer cases between care providers. It also functions as the National TB Surveillance System and enables reporting of surveillance data to the Government of India.
objectives: To register TB cases under care
To order various types of tests from Labs across the country
To record treatment details and monitor treatment adherence
To transfer cases between care providers
To function as the National TB Surveillance System
To enable reporting of various surveillance data to the Government of India
eligibility: Health functionaries at various levels across the country, both in the public and private sector, who are involved in TB case management under the National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme (NTEP).
benefits: Enables case registration, test ordering from labs, treatment recording, adherence monitoring, case transfer between providers, national TB surveillance, and reporting of surveillance data to the Government of India. The service is provided at no cost by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.
financial_support: The Nikshay application is provided by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India, at no cost to users. There is no financial support disbursed to beneficiaries under this digital initiative.
application_process: 1. Visit the Nikshay portal at https://nikshay.in 2. Click on 'Login' to access the system 3. For new users, register via 'New Health Facility Registration' or 'New Informant Registration' as applicable 4. Complete the required registration form with details such as state, district, block, facility, address, basic information, designation, contact number, email, and bank details (if applicable) 5. Create login credentials (username) 6. Submit the form for approval 7. Upon approval, use the login credentials to access the Nikshay dashboard 8. Navigate to relevant modules such as case registration, test ordering, treatment monitoring, etc.
required_documents: Designation (ASHA, NGO Volunteer, Other Community Volunteer, Private Practitioner, Physician, Nurse, Other Para Medical Staff, Attendant, Citizen, Informal Provider)
Bank details (IFSC Code, Bank Name, Account Number) - if opting for benefits
deadlines: Rolling basis — no fixed deadline. Registrations are accepted year-round.
implementing_agency: Central TB Division (CTD TB Division (CTD), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
caveats: The service is provided 'as is' with no cost
In view of the recent Supreme Court judgement on Aadhaar, revised procedure details will be provided soon
Data retention and deletion policies apply as per the Privacy Policy
Users must provide accurate and complete information during registration
